summary: FS Credit Real Estate Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect wholly owned financing subsidiary, FS CREIT Finance WF-2 LLC, entered on October 16, 2026 into Amendment No. 2 to its Master Repurchase and Securities Contract Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. as buyer. The amendment extends the facility maturity to October 18, 2027 and sets a maximum facility amount of $79,330,309.85. The Company and FS CREIT Finance Holdings LLC acknowledge as guarantor. This is a routine financing/credit-facility amendment under Items 1.01 and 2.03, not a special situation; no deal, premium, or ownership change arises. Watch only for collateral mark and advance-rate terms.
